<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>On the third of Kislev, he writes again regarding the parchment for the Sefer Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">However, on the third of Kislev he writes to him again:</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>He notes that the parchment will be expensive, so they plan to prepare it locally.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"Regarding the parchment for the Sefer Torah, it will indeed be expensive, so we intend to do this here."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>They obtained the parchment in the United States despite wartime difficulties, and after beginning the writing, he turned to Rabbi Eliyahu Nachum Shklier.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The parchment, however, they obtained in the United States,</t>
    <t s="1">despite the difficulties in obtaining parchment at that time,</t>
    <t s="2">because most hides were taken at that time by the government</t>
    <t s="3">(for war needs).</t>
    <t s="4">And after the beginning of the writing, he turned regarding this matter,</t>
    <t s="5">on the sixth of Iyar 5702,</t>
    <t s="6">to the honorable Rabbi Eliyahu Nachum Shklier.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
